description:
"I'm cursed to fall in love with you." The most beautiful woman, the angel of the Angela Empire, 'Vanessa Rohawk'. When my family collapsed overnight as traitors, the one saved me was the owner of the Principality of Vincart and Vanessa's lover, 'Declen Vincart'. "Vanessa Rohawk. Would you like to come with me?" He was my salvation, he was my light, he was my love. As long as I could be by your side, I could endure any hardship I swore that not even death would ever separate us. This relationship should never have started in the first place. "Vanessa, you can never walk away from me without my permission."
